The topic of policy change in this corpus centers on methodological updates to clinical reporting and calculation standards. Specifically, a major policy shift dictates how [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] is measured using [[sks-koder|SKS-koder]] (SKS codes). Effective January 1, 2023, a new rule mandates that only the specific SKS code "BFKB" is to be used for these calculations [^src1]. As a result, the 2023 annual report serves as the final document where older, additional codes are included in the calculation for Indikator 8 [^src1]. This transition simplifies future reporting by restricting the metric to a single, standardized code.

## Claims
- Fra og med 1.1.2023 er det alene SKS-koden BFKB der anvendes og denne årsrapport er således den sidste hvor de øvrige indgår i beregningen[^src1] (indikator-8, sks-koder)
